polls.description: China is aggressively advancing its AI capabilities through massive investments, BRICS partnerships, and open-source initiatives while pushing back against Western slowdown calls.
polls.question: Is China's AI expansion a competitive threat or innovation opportunity?

cluster_stories.title: Kamala Harris asks Congress for a new AI regulator and a treaty with China
cluster_stories.summary: Kamala Harris posted a four-paragraph statement on X on Monday night setting out what she wants Washington to do about AI. She asked Congress to pass new laws and “establish a new federal entity to provide oversight and independent testing” for frontier models. cluster_stories.headline: KAMALA HARRIS CALLS FOR NEW AI REGULATOR... CHINA TREATY

cluster_stories.title: Beijing answers Amodei’s AI slowdown plan by calling it a Cold War script
cluster_stories.summary: Dario Amodei’s essay on Saturday made the case that the AI industry must slow itself down. It also asked Washington to “not sell powerful AI chips or semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China” and to crack down on smuggling and on remote access to data centres outside the country. cluster_stories.headline: BEIJING FIRES BACK: Amodei's AI Slowdown a 'Cold War Script'

cluster_stories.title: China Rejects AI ‘Fearmongering’ After Amodei Urges Slowdown
cluster_stories.summary: China criticized warnings from leading US technology executives to put the brakes on artificial intelligence development and claims that Chinese progress posed a dire security threat to the world.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA REJECTS AI 'Fearmongering' After Amodei Urges Slowdown

cluster_stories.title: Trump downplays need to check AI development, says he is unwilling to cede edge to China
cluster_stories.summary: US President Donald Trump on Sunday played down the need for his administration to check the development of artificial intelligence, saying he worried about ceding America’s edge over China in a global competition and that winning would help address the risks from the advancing technology. cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP: Won't Slow AI... China Competition Too Fierce

cluster_stories.title: Chinese President Xi announces open-source AI ecosystem in 5-point BRICS plan
cluster_stories.summary: Xi's announcement at the concluding session of the BRICS summit is widely seen as an effort to position Beijing as a central technology partner for the BRICS amid the communist State's growing AI competition with the US.
cluster_stories.headline: XI JINPING UNVEILS OPEN-SOURCE AI PLAN FOR BRICS

cluster_stories.title: Xi Pitches His AI Vision at BRICS Summit as China Duels With US
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping has sought to turn the annual BRICS summit into another platform for championing Beijing’s vision for artificial intelligence, as it vies for global influence over the technology with the US.
cluster_stories.headline: XI CHAMPIONS AI VISION AT BRICS SUMMIT

cluster_stories.title: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule

cluster_stories.headline: CHINA HITS BACK at AI Slowdown Calls... Spy Chief Warns Party at Risk

cluster_stories.title: Hostile forces using AI for ‘cognitive warfare’ against China, spy agency warns
cluster_stories.summary: Beijing signals growing concern over how rapid advances in technology could be used against the country
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA SPY AGENCY: Hostile Forces Using AI for 'Cognitive Warfare'

cluster_stories.title: Xi pitches open-source AI to BRICS as Beijing weighs curbs on its own models
cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping used the BRICS summit to propose a China-led community for open-source AI and to invite members into the World AI Cooperation Organization, a Beijing-founded body of 29 countries with no EU state among them. cluster_stories.headline: XI PITCHES OPEN-SOURCE AI TO BRICS NATIONS

cluster_stories.title: China's spy chief warns of national security risks from AI
cluster_stories.summary: The head of China's spy agency has warned that artificial intelligence endangers the country's national security, with foreign powers potentially using the technology to threaten social order. "Foreign intelligence agencies are deeply using technologies such as intelligent web crawlers, intelligent data mining, and intelligent profiling analysis to extensively collect and acquire sensitive information such as key national data, trade secrets, and citizens' personal privacy," Chen said.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA SPY CHIEF: AI Threatens National Security

cluster_stories.title: China state newspaper blasts Anthropic's calls to slow AI as 'Cold War' tactic
cluster_stories.summary: In the essay published on Saturday and later endorsed by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and ‌SpaceX founder Elon ⁠Musk, ⁠Dario Amodei outlined a framework to pace the development of frontier AI model capabilities and ​create more time to manage mounting safety risks.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA ATTACKS Anthropic's AI Slowdown as 'Cold War Tactic'

cluster_stories.title: China’s data regulator plans standards for embodied AI, ten days after industry asked
cluster_stories.summary: China’s National Data Administration said it will develop standards for embodied AI data and guide local authorities on the work, ten days after seven companies asked it for exactly that. Europe regulates who may reach the data a machine generates but has no programme producing it, and the data labs promised in its Data Union […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA FAST-TRACKS EMBODIED AI STANDARDS

cluster_stories.title: China’s Data Regulator Plans Standards Push for Embodied AI
cluster_stories.summary: China’s data regulator said it plans to develop standards for embodied artificial intelligence and guide local authorities in related work, as demand for high-quality, diverse and large-scale datasets continues to grow.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA PUSHES EMBODIED AI STANDARDS NATIONWIDE

cluster_stories.title: China’s AI industry is moving from models to agents, a state report says
cluster_stories.summary: China’s AI industry is moving from competing on models to deploying agents, and the China Telecom Research Institute expects inference to reach 80% of the country’s compute market by 2029. Europe’s answer is seven gigafactories whose bids close in November and whose machines are due to run by mid-2028, on a EUR 30bn budget of […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA PIVOTS: AI Industry Shifts From Models to Agents

cluster_stories.title: China’s AI Industry Pivots to Agents From Models, Report Says
cluster_stories.summary: China’s artificial intelligence industry is shifting from competition in large models and computing power toward the deployment and commercialization of AI agents, according to a report by the China Telecom Research Institute cited by China Central Television on Saturday.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA AI PIVOT: State Report Shows Agents Over Models

cluster_stories.title: AI Chip Darling Biren Said to Mull $1 Billion Share Sale
cluster_stories.summary: Shanghai Biren Technology Co. is weighing another share sale to help finance its artificial intelligence ambitions, according to people familiar with the situation.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA AI CHIP DARLING Biren Eyes $1B Fundraise
